# useLayouts source notice

This repository includes five upstream useLayouts component source snapshots under `third_party/uselayouts/upstream/`:

- Discrete Tabs
- Dynamic Toolbar
- Smooth Dropdown
- Bento Card
- Save Button

Upstream project: https://github.com/iurvish/uselayouts
Project site: https://uselayouts.com
License: MIT, copyright (c) 2025 Urvish Mali.

The production components under `components/uselayouts/` adapt those interactions to Cyberouter Lab's existing JavaScript/CSS architecture while preserving the characteristic motion patterns and behavior. The unmodified upstream source snapshots are kept here for traceability and attribution.
